question: C3: for the linear models beyond HAR + RM + FOMC, which comparison does the paper report: each class against its own base, or against OLS on the base?

solvers.answer: Each class vs its own base; scope 'every bar'; lasso statement-day caveat; one OLS-on-base sentence; penalized test A replaces the OLS one ('little', not 'none').
Each class vs its own penalized base; OLS-base split only in the appendix; penalized test A for tab:rh_factor.
Same; scope 'every bar and ordinary days'; disclose OLS on HAR + RM + FOMC; add that row to tab:rh_ablation.

refutation.note: The 27 Oct 'exactly the same design' quote is superseded by the 28 Oct 'they're cheap, and they make the results apples to apples. run it.' (a38439f). Numbers: own-base every bar ridge +0.1%, lasso -0.6%, enet -0.6%, all n.s.; lasso -6.4% on statement days (p < 0.001), so the claim survives only scoped.

precedence_note: 28 Oct (penalized test commissioned) supersedes 27 Oct (OLS-based design) on the same scope.
final_answer: Main text: 'On every bar and on ordinary days the other 36 series add no significant accuracy to any penalized linear model', plus one sentence that OLS on HAR + RM + FOMC is as accurate on every bar as the penalized full sets (-9.2% vs OLS-HAR). tab:rh_factor switches to (or reports beside) the penalized test A; 'recovers none' becomes 'little'.
answer_short: Each linear class against its own base, scoped to every bar and ordinary days; OLS on HAR + RM + FOMC disclosed; the factor table moves to the penalized test.

actions.detail: Macros and a table for tests A/B and the penalization split, from existing results.
OLS HAR + RM + FOMC cell or Panel C row.
Scope 'on every bar'; OLS-on-base sentence; l.236-243 on the penalized test A. Waits for the author's answer to Q8 (Q-2026-10-29-09); applied in whichever layer he reads first.

consequences: One new generator, one generator extended, scope wording in the introduction, conclusion and Section 6.3, and the factor table.
recommendation: Within-class comparison, scoped; disclose OLS on the base.
default: Applied; text edits wait for the answer to Q8.
